blocks.text: Issue tracking built for speed - the tool engineering teams actually enjoy using

Linear was built by engineers who were frustrated with slow, bloated project management tools. The result is an issue tracker that feels as fast as a native app - keyboard shortcuts for everything, instant search, and sub-100ms response times throughout the interface.

For engineering teams, Linear's opinionated workflow removes decision fatigue. Issues move through a clear lifecycle (Backlog → Todo → In Progress → Done), cycles keep work time-boxed, and automated workflows handle the bookkeeping that nobody wants to do manually.

The integration with development tools is deep and thoughtful. Connect your GitHub or GitLab repos and Linear automatically links PRs to issues, moves issues to "In Progress" when a branch is created, and closes them when PRs merge. Your issue tracker stays current without anyone manually updating statuses.
Sub-100ms interactions with keyboard shortcuts for every action
Sprint planning with automatic carry-over and visual roadmap views
Auto-links PRs, moves issues on branch creation, closes on merge
Inbox-style issue triage that keeps backlogs clean and prioritized
Organize work across teams with cross-project views and filters
Full GraphQL API for building custom integrations and workflows
Linear is the only project management tool we have seen that engineers actually want to use. The speed and keyboard-driven workflow mean less time managing tasks and more time building product.
Our team can integrate Linear into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
